_comment: Narrowing vectors for SPEC-agent-lease-manifest.md section 5 and the refusals of section 5.2.
Generated from the reference implementation (CDF Harness, src/governance/leases/narrow.ts) by
Each vector has `declared` and `parent` (a GRANTED manifest with its REMAINING budget), and either
`granted` (compare by canonical bytes) or `refusals` (compare the set of R1..R6 exactly).
A vector with `schema_invalid: true` is refused by the schemas at validation (section 9 step 1):
a conforming implementation never narrows it, so only its invalidity is checked, and `refusals`
records which section 5.2 condition the schema enforces. `diff` is informative.
